BBD.definition: Beta Business Days is the two-day career event for all students from the Faculty of Science and Engineering of the University of Groningen.

Bètastuf.definition: The Bèta Student Federation (Bètastuf) is a foundation that bridges student representatives in the Faculty of Science and Engineering and the University. Bètastuf aims to unify student representatives from all levels of our university, by providing an independent platform to voice the collective interest of these students and to develop student driven policies for our faculty.

CTF.definition: Cover Travel Foundation is set up to support big financial expenditures for the ExCee and the MxCee.

NSVKI/LOKI.definition: National Artificial Intelligence study associations meeting in the Netherlands.

SAM.definition: Study association meeting for the associations of the Faculty of Science and Engineering.

SNiC.definition: An annual national conference with a computer science related subject.

WISO.definition: National Computing Science and Mathematics study associations meeting in the Netherlands.

Financial year.definition: The period for which the financial year report is established. The financial year of the association is from the 1st of August until the 31st of July.

Liquidity.definition: The total amount of money we currently own in currency and giro (NL: giraal + chartaal).

Relation.definition: Partnered companies, members, other associations, or other legal entities with whom we’re financially involved.

Reservation.definition: Money put aside for events in the next financial year (this money will be spend in the next year).

AudiCee.definition: The GA Committee that makes sure the Treasurer of the Board does their work properly. This Committee is appointed by the General Assembly and mostly consists of previous treasurers.

AC/DCee.definition: AC/DCee (Advanced Computing & Digitisation Committee) is the Committee responsible for maintaining all our digital infrastructure, like our website or our mail server.

ActiviTee.definition: Is the Committee responsible for socially oriented events, like parties or fun sit-downs.

Application committee.definition: The GA committee that is responsible for board applications. This committee formulates advice for the formation of the next board, which is presented at the General Assembly.

BoA.definition: The GA Committee that provides advice to the Board throughout the year, consisting of former Board members.

ComExA.definition: ComExA (Committee of External Affairs) is responsible for organising career-oriented activities and supporting the Commissioner of External Affairs. The Commissioner of External Affairs of the Board is simultaneously the chair of this committee.

DisCover.definition: The Committee responsible for producing the magazine, DisCover.

ExCee.definition: ExCee (Excursion Committee) is responsible for organising an excursion every year.

HEROcee.definition: HEROcee provides EROs when required for an event.

IntroCee.definition: IntroCee (Introduction Committee) organises the introduction activities, such as the introduction weekend and the introduction week afterparty.

DLCee.definition: DLCee (Drinking and Lan Committee) organises the LAN and, every year, as well as drinking and gaming-related events.

LustrumCee.definition: Organises the lustrum. A lustrum is a 5-year birthday for the association.

PhotoCee.definition: PhotoCee is responsible for taking pictures at activities and uploading them to the website.

PropaganDee.definition: PropaganDee is responsible for creating the promotional posters and the upkeep of our Instagram

SporTee.definition: SporTee is responsible for organising sports-related activities.

StudCee.definition: StudCee is responsible for organising study support sessions and study related skills workshops.

SympoCee.definition: SympoCee is responsible for organising the yearly symposium.

HR - R&R.definition: The document that states the rules and regulations of the association. Changes to this document must be approved by the general assembly.

Statuten - Constitution.definition: The body of fundamental principles and established precedents according to which the association is acknowledged to be governed. These rules are legally binding and overrule the R&R.

Active member.definition: An active member is part of any committee or working group.

Board.definition: The governing organ of the association.

Donor.definition: Someone who wishes to contribute to the association. Anyone can become a Donor by simply donating to the Association. For more information see the R&R.

Committee guidelines.definition: The document that describes the goals and responsibilities of committees.

Member.definition: Everybody that is acknowledged by the board as a member and pays their contribution fee.

Policy plan.definition: The document that states the ambitions and plans of the board for the academic year.

SD.definition: Standard Documents is the portion of the website where documents are provided as well as templates to create new documents (sd.svcover.nl)

Working group.definition: A group of members who work on a set goal for a set amount of time. After achieving this goal, the working group is disbanded. Recent examples include the R&R revision working group.

For approval.definition: Some topics on a GA agenda may be for approval. For such topics, an accompanying document is supplied, on the approval of which shall be voted. To approve a document, a quorum is required.

Cover.definition: Study Association for BSc/MSc Artificial Intelligence, BSc/MSc Computing Science and Computational Cognitive Science

GA Committee.definition: A GA committee is established by the General Assembly and is there either for legal reasons, like AudiCee, or to handle things outside of the Board's influence, like the Application Committee or the Board of Advisors.

Board Committee.definition: A Board Committee is established by the board and is supposed to take on a Board task. Such tasks can include organizing events, such as sports events, or providing support for the Board, such as providing ERO at an event.

Society.definition: A society is a group of people with shared interests, like playing board games or competitive drinking.

Quorum.definition: Quorum is the minimum number of members that attend a General Assembly for a document to be approved in a General Assembly (quorum.svcover.nl).
